svg.title: Fewer rounds of "make it better"
svg.desc: Review rounds until a design reviewer would ship the page. Fewer is better. 18 runs on 3 pages. Sonnet builds; Opus reviews screenshots without knowing which arm made them. Never shipped counts as 5. A small first sample.
